name: NostrKey
summary: Cryptographic identity SDK for AI agents — generate Nostr keypairs, sign events, encrypt messages, persist identity

NOSTRKEY_PASSPHRASE.description: Passphrase used to encrypt/decrypt the agent's identity file

NOSTRKEY_REVEAL_CODE.description: Operator-set proof-of-presence code required by Identity.export_nsec / export_seed_phrase. Constant-time compared. Without it, the gated reveal path refuses.

NOSTRKEY_AUDIT_LOG.description: Override path for the reveal audit log. Defaults to ~/.nostrkey/reveal_audit.log. Each gated export attempt (success or failure) appends one TSV row.
